# Test fixtures

Every file here is synthetic. None of it describes a real member or employer.

- File IDs start with `SYNTH-`.
- NI numbers start with `QQ`, a prefix that is never issued.
- Employer IDs are in the test range `E9xxxx`. Bank details are `99-00-xx` / `0000000x`.
- Names are invented.

`tests/unit/test_fixtures_are_synthetic.py` checks the first three rules. Never copy real
member or employer records into this folder, even with the names changed.
